title: Interaction Design & Micro-interactions
description: Design how interfaces respond to user input. Tests form validation, notification systems, and gesture-based interactions.

seo.overviewBody: Interaction design turns static screens into engaging, responsive user experiences. Designers demonstrate technical capability by crafting micro-interactions, configuring easing animation curves (200-300ms timing), designing interactive state feedback, and mapping gesture controls.

deliverables.title: 1. Micro-Interaction Specification & Animation Specs
deliverables.desc: Spec document defining UI trigger events, animation durations (ms), easing curves (cubic-bezier), and spatial transformations.

deliverables.title: 2. Interactive Figma Prototype with Micro-Animations
deliverables.desc: Figma prototype demonstrating hover states, active press feedback, animated toggle switches, and page transition loaders.

deliverables.title: 3. UI Easing Curve & Feedback System Guide
deliverables.desc: Design guide establishing standard timing parameters and feedback states for interactive components.

faqs.question: What is the ideal duration for UI micro-interactions?
faqs.answer: UI micro-interactions should last between 200ms and 300ms. Anything faster feels abrupt; anything slower than 400ms feels sluggish.

faqs.question: Why are easing curves (ease-in-out) used in UI animation instead of linear movement?
faqs.answer: Physical objects in the real world accelerate and decelerate naturally. Linear animations feel robotic and unnatural to the human eye.

faqs.question: What is a feedback loop in interaction design?
faqs.answer: A feedback loop provides instant visual, audio, or haptic confirmation that the system received a user input (e.g. a button changing state when pressed).
